description: This PHP source file defines the class UserViewHelper, which handles the rendering and setup of user-related views in a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for configuring user type dropdowns, theme settings, email preferences, locale settings, and other user-specific interface elements.

classes.name: UserViewHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing the setup and rendering of user detail and edit views in SuiteCRM, including user type, theme, locale, email, and advanced settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with Smarty template handler, bean, and view type.

methods.name: setupAdditionalFields
methods.description: Sets up additional user fields and interface components by calling various setup methods.

methods.name: assignUserTypes
methods.description: Assigns flags related to user admin and group status; determines user type and permissions.

methods.name: setupButtonsAndTabs
methods.description: Configures buttons and tabs for the user view interface.

methods.name: setupUserTypeDropdown
methods.description: Builds the user type dropdown selection based on current user permissions and context.

methods.name: setupPasswordTab
methods.description: Prepares password-related interface settings based on configuration and user type.

methods.name: setupThemeTab
methods.description: Sets up theme selection options and visibility based on available themes and current preferences.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTab
methods.description: Initializes advanced settings sections including user preferences, team, navigation, locale, and PDF settings.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTabUserSettings
methods.description: Configures user-specific advanced settings such as notification preferences and language options.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTabNavSettings
methods.description: Configures navigation and module tab visibility preferences.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTabLocaleSettings
methods.description: Configures locale settings including date/time formats, timezone, number formatting, and currency.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTabPdfSettings
methods.description: Placeholder for PDF-specific advanced settings (empty in current code).

methods.name: setupEmailSettings
methods.description: Prepares email configuration options including SMTP settings, email address widgets, link types, and editor preferences.

methods.name: setUserType
methods.description: Determines and sets the user_type attribute based on whether the user is admin, group, or regular.
